meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与小分子的结合构象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是从事药物设计或结构生物学的科研人员
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a researcher in drug design or structural biology

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 DiffDock 根据蛋白质结构(PDB)或序列,将小分子配体(SMILES/SDF/MOL2)对接出 3D 结合姿态,并给出置信度分数;支持批量对接与虚拟筛选,但不预测结合亲和力。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求进行蛋白质-小分子对接(如“对接这个配体”“预测结合姿态”“跑虚拟筛选”)时触发;也适用于批量处理和置信度解读。

say.text: 用这个 SDF 配体和这个 PDB 蛋白做一次分子对接,输出前 3 个姿态。
把这批化合物的 SMILES 和蛋白列表做成 CSV,批量虚拟筛选。
解释一下刚才对接结果的置信度分数,并列出头部姿态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses DiffDock to dock small-molecule ligands (SMILES/SDF/MOL2) into proteins from PDB structure or sequence, predicting 3D binding poses with confidence scores; supports batch docking and virtual screening, but not binding affinity prediction.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for protein-ligand docking such as "dock this ligand", "predict binding pose", or "run virtual screening", and for batch processing or confidence interpretation.

say_en.text: Dock this SDF ligand to this PDB protein and output the top 3 poses.
Make a CSV with these compound SMILES and protein list, then run batch virtual screening.
Explain the confidence scores from the docking results and list the top poses.
